sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Let $\alpha, \beta \in \mathbb{R}$ be such that the system of linear equations $x+2y+z=5$, $2x+y+\alpha z=5$, $8x+4y+\beta z=18$ has no solution. Then $\frac{\beta}{\alpha}$ is equal to :
stem.hi: माना $\alpha, \beta \in \mathbb{R}$ ऐसे हैं कि रैखिक समीकरण निकाय $x+2y+z=5$, $2x+y+\alpha z=5$, $8x+4y+\beta z=18$ का कोई हल नहीं है। तब $\frac{\beta}{\alpha}$ बराबर है :

feynman.en: No solution needs the coefficient determinant to vanish. Once it does, the third equation's left side is exactly four times the second's, but the right sides are not, so the system clashes.
feynman.hi: हल न होने के लिए गुणांक सारणिक शून्य होना चाहिए। तब तीसरे समीकरण का बायाँ पक्ष ठीक दूसरे का चार गुना है, पर दाएँ पक्ष नहीं, इसलिए निकाय असंगत है।

steps.en: With $\beta=4\alpha$, the third left side is $4(2x+y+\alpha z)=20$, but the equation demands $18$: inconsistent for every $\alpha \neq 0$.
steps.hi: $\beta=4\alpha$ होने पर तीसरा बायाँ पक्ष $4(2x+y+\alpha z)=20$ है, पर समीकरण $18$ माँगता है: प्रत्येक $\alpha \neq 0$ के लिए असंगत।
